+package store

+func prepareSupportedHomeAtVersion(t *testing.T, db *DB, version int64) {
+	t.Helper()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	for _, statement := range []string{
+		`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS greenhouse_task_watches`,
+		`ALTER TABLE project_lookout_pollers DROP COLUMN executable_version`,
+		`ALTER TABLE project_lookout_pollers DROP COLUMN executable_modified_at`,
+		`ALTER TABLE project_lookout_pollers DROP COLUMN executable_size`,
+		`DROP INDEX IF EXISTS tasks_project_seq_idx`,
+		`DROP INDEX IF EXISTS tasks_project_pane_label_idx`,
+		`DROP INDEX IF EXISTS tasks_project_workflow_idx`,
+		`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task_plan_input_migration`,
+		`ALTER TABLE tasks DROP COLUMN plan_revision`,
+		`ALTER TABLE tasks DROP COLUMN workflow_run_id`,
+		`DELETE FROM goose_db_version`,
+		`DELETE FROM posse_migration_checksums`,
+		`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(0,1)`,
+		`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(95,1)`,
+		`INSERT INTO posse_migration_checksums(version,sha256) VALUES(95,'` + supportedLegacyMigrationChecksums[95] + `')`,
+	} {
+		if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, statement); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	sources, err := embeddedMigrations()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, source := range sources {
+		if source.version <= 95 || source.version > version || source.version >= baselineMigrationVersion {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(?,1)`, source.version); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO posse_migration_checksums(version,sha256) VALUES(?,?)`, source.version, source.checksum); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+}

+func TestOpenAppliesBaselineAsOneMigration(t *testing.T) {
+	db, err := OpenAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "posse.db"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)

+	if err := db.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goose_db_version WHERE is_applied=1 AND version_id>0`).Scan(&applied); err != nil || applied != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("applied migration count = %d, %v; want one baseline", applied, err)
+	}
+	var version int64
+	if err := db.QueryRow(`SELECT MAX(version_id) FROM goose_db_version WHERE is_applied=1`).Scan(&version); err != nil || version != baselineMigrationVersion {
+		t.Fatalf("applied baseline version = %d, %v; want %d", version, err, baselineMigrationVersion)
+	}
+	var watches int
+	if err := db.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='greenhouse_task_watches'`).Scan(&watches); err != nil || watches != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("greenhouse_task_watches table count = %d, %v; want 1", watches, err)
+	}
+	for _, column := range []string{"executable_size", "executable_modified_at", "executable_version"} {
+		var count int
+		if err := db.QueryRow(`SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pragma_table_info('project_lookout_pollers') WHERE name=?`, column).Scan(&count); err != nil || count != 1 {
+			t.Fatalf("project_lookout_pollers.%s count = %d, %v; want 1", column, count, err)

+	}
+}

+func TestOpenUpgradesSupportedHomeFromVersion95WithData(t *testing.T) {

+			t.Fatalf("migration %d applied rows = %d, %v; want 1", version, applied, err)

+func TestOpenUpgradesVersion99HomeThroughVersion101BeforeBaseline(t *testing.T) {
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	home := t.TempDir()
+	path := filepath.Join(home, "posse.db")
+	db, err := OpenAt(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	project, err := db.CreateProject(ctx, "upgrade-check", "/repo", "main")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	plan := admittedStorePlan(t, home).Bind("t1")
+	plan.Inputs = append(plan.Inputs, taskplan.Select("review-round-file", "review/legacy.patch", bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x5a}, 1<<20)))
+	inline, err := plan.Encode()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	taskID, err := db.CreateTask(ctx, project.ID, Task{Seq: 1, Type: "change", Title: "Preserve inline plan", MergeMode: "local", PlanJSON: inline})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE tasks SET plan_json=?,plan_revision=0 WHERE id=?`, inline, taskID); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, `UPDATE task_plan_revisions SET plan_json=? WHERE task_id=?`, inline, taskID); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	prepareSupportedHomeAtVersion(t, db, 99)
+	if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, `CREATE TRIGGER require_plan_input_migration_before_baseline BEFORE INSERT ON goose_db_version WHEN NEW.version_id=20261120180000 AND (SELECT completed FROM task_plan_input_migration WHERE id=1)<>1 BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT,'task plan input migration incomplete'); END`); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)

+	if err := db.Close(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	db, err = OpenAt(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("open version 99 home: %v", err)
+	}
+	defer db.Close()
+	got, err := db.ProjectByID(ctx, project.ID)
+	if err != nil || got.Name != project.Name {
+		t.Fatalf("project after baseline = %#v, %v; want preserved project %q", got, err, project.Name)
+	}
+	for version := int64(100); version <= 101; version++ {
+		var applied int
+		if err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goose_db_version WHERE version_id=? AND is_applied=1`, version).Scan(&applied); err != nil || applied != 1 {
+			t.Fatalf("migration %d applied rows = %d, %v; want 1", version, applied, err)
+		}
+	}
+	var completed int
+	if err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT completed FROM task_plan_input_migration WHERE id=1`).Scan(&completed); err != nil || completed != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("task plan input migration completed = %d, %v; want 1 before baseline", completed, err)
+	}
+	var baselineApplied int
+	if err := db.QueryRowContext(ctx, `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM goose_db_version WHERE version_id=? AND is_applied=1`, baselineMigrationVersion).Scan(&baselineApplied); err != nil || baselineApplied != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("baseline migration rows = %d, %v; want 1", baselineApplied, err)
+	}
+	migrated, err := db.TaskByID(ctx, project.ID, taskID)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	storedPlan, err := migrated.AdmittedPlan()
+	if err != nil || storedPlan == nil || storedPlan.SHA256() != plan.SHA256() || len(storedPlan.Inputs[len(storedPlan.Inputs)-1].Bytes) != 1<<20 {
+		t.Fatalf("plan after upgrade lost content: plan=%v err=%v", storedPlan != nil, err)
+	}
+}
+
+func TestOpenRefusesHomesOlderThanMinimumSupportedVersion(t *testing.T) {
+	path := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "posse.db")
+	db, err := OpenAt(path)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, statement := range []string{
+		`DELETE FROM goose_db_version WHERE version_id>94`,
+		`DELETE FROM posse_migration_checksums WHERE version>94`,
+		`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(94,1)`,
+		`INSERT INTO posse_migration_checksums(version,sha256) VALUES(94,'old-release')`,
+	} {
+		if _, err := db.Exec(statement); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	if err := db.Close(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	_, err = OpenAt(path)
+	if err == nil || !containsAll(err.Error(), "too old for direct upgrade", "v0.33.0") {
+		t.Fatalf("Open error = %v; want minimum-version error naming v0.33.0", err)
+	}
+}
+
+func containsAll(s string, parts ...string) bool {
+	for _, part := range parts {
+		if !strings.Contains(s, part) {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+package store
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"database/sql"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+type schemaFixture struct {
+	Objects []struct {
+		Type  string `json:"type"`
+		Name  string `json:"name"`
+		Table string `json:"table"`
+		SQL   string `json:"sql"`
+	} `json:"objects"`
+	AppliedMigrations []struct {
+		Version  int64  `json:"version"`
+		Checksum string `json:"checksum"`
+	} `json:"applied_migrations"`
+}
+
+func TestV033HomeUpgradesToBaselineSchema(t *testing.T) {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "v033.0-schema.json"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var fixture schemaFixture
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &fixture); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	legacyPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "legacy.db")
+	legacy, err := sql.Open("sqlite", legacyPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer legacy.Close()
+	sort.Slice(fixture.Objects, func(i, j int) bool {
+		order := map[string]int{"table": 0, "index": 1, "trigger": 2, "view": 3}
+		if order[fixture.Objects[i].Type] != order[fixture.Objects[j].Type] {
+			return order[fixture.Objects[i].Type] < order[fixture.Objects[j].Type]
+		}
+		return fixture.Objects[i].Name < fixture.Objects[j].Name
+	})
+	for _, object := range fixture.Objects {
+		if _, err := legacy.Exec(object.SQL); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("apply v0.33.0 %s %s DDL: %v", object.Type, object.Name, err)
+		}
+	}
+	if _, err := legacy.Exec(`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(0,1)`); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, migration := range fixture.AppliedMigrations {
+		if _, err := legacy.Exec(`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(?,1)`, migration.Version); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if _, err := legacy.Exec(`INSERT INTO posse_migration_checksums(version,sha256) VALUES(?,?)`, migration.Version, migration.Checksum); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	if err := legacy.Close(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	upgraded, err := OpenAt(legacyPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("upgrade v0.33.0 home: %v", err)
+	}
+	defer upgraded.Close()
+	fresh, err := OpenAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "fresh.db"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("open fresh baseline home: %v", err)
+	}
+	defer fresh.Close()
+	got := normalizedSchema(t, upgraded)
+	want := normalizedSchema(t, fresh)
+	if strings.Join(got, "\n") != strings.Join(want, "\n") {
+		t.Fatalf("upgraded schema differs from fresh baseline:\n%s", schemaDifference(want, got))
+	}
+}
+
+func normalizedSchema(t *testing.T, db *DB) []string {
+	t.Helper()
+	rows, err := db.QueryContext(context.Background(), `SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','index','trigger','view') ORDER BY type,name`)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer rows.Close()
+	var schema []string
+	for rows.Next() {
+		var kind, name, table string
+		var statement sql.NullString
+		if err := rows.Scan(&kind, &name, &table, &statement); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if statement.Valid {
+			schema = append(schema, fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%s|%s", kind, name, table, normalizeSQL(statement.String)))
+		}
+	}
+	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(schema)
+	return schema
+}
+
+func normalizeSQL(statement string) string {
+	statement = strings.Join(strings.Fields(statement), " ")
+	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " (", "(")
+	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, "( ", "(")
+	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " )", ")")
+	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " ,", ",")
+	return statement
+}
+
+func schemaDifference(want, got []string) string {
+	wantSet, gotSet := map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}
+	for _, statement := range want {
+		wantSet[statement] = true
+	}
+	for _, statement := range got {
+		gotSet[statement] = true
+	}
+	var differences []string
+	for statement := range wantSet {
+		if !gotSet[statement] {
+			differences = append(differences, "missing: "+statement)
+		}
+	}
+	for statement := range gotSet {
+		if !wantSet[statement] {
+			differences = append(differences, "extra: "+statement)
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(differences)
+	return strings.Join(differences, "\n")
+}

+UPDATE greenhouse_review_requests AS keeper
+SET settled_at = (SELECT settled_at FROM greenhouse_review_requests latest WHERE latest.task_id=keeper.task_id AND latest.repo=keeper.repo AND latest.grant_id=keeper.grant_id ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1),
+    outcome = (SELECT outcome FROM greenhouse_review_requests latest WHERE latest.task_id=keeper.task_id AND latest.repo=keeper.repo AND latest.grant_id=keeper.grant_id ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1),
+    verdict_id = (SELECT verdict_id FROM greenhouse_review_requests latest WHERE latest.task_id=keeper.task_id AND latest.repo=keeper.repo AND latest.grant_id=keeper.grant_id ORDER BY latest.id DESC LIMIT 1)
+WHERE keeper.grant_id IS NOT NULL AND keeper.id=(SELECT MIN(first.id) FROM greenhouse_review_requests first WHERE first.task_id=keeper.task_id AND first.repo=keeper.repo AND first.grant_id=keeper.grant_id)
+  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM greenhouse_review_requests duplicate WHERE duplicate.task_id=keeper.task_id AND duplicate.repo=keeper.repo AND duplicate.grant_id=keeper.grant_id GROUP BY duplicate.task_id,duplicate.repo,duplicate.grant_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1);

+CREATE TRIGGER greenhouse_review_requests_no_delete BEFORE DELETE ON greenhouse_review_requests
+BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Greenhouse review request is insert-only'); END;
+CREATE TRIGGER greenhouse_review_requests_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON greenhouse_review_requests
+WHEN NOT (
+    OLD.outcome = 'failed' AND OLD.grant_id IS NOT NULL AND
+    NEW.id = OLD.id AND NEW.project_id = OLD.project_id AND NEW.task_id = OLD.task_id AND
+    NEW.repo = OLD.repo AND NEW.requested_head = OLD.requested_head AND NEW.provider = OLD.provider AND
+    NEW.requested_at = OLD.requested_at AND NEW.grant_id = OLD.grant_id AND
+    NEW.settled_at >= OLD.settled_at AND NEW.outcome IN ('failed', 'verdict', 'refused', 'head_mismatch')
+)
+BEGIN SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'Greenhouse review request is immutable'); END;
+
+-- +goose Down
+DROP TRIGGER greenhouse_review_requests_immutable;
+DROP TRIGGER greenhouse_review_requests_no_delete;

--- README.md ---
1: ![Posse: One Lead. A whole crew. Running on Herdr.](docs/banner.svg)
2: 
3: # Posse
4: 
5: **One Lead. A whole crew. Running on Herdr.**
6: 
7: The name stands for Personal Orchestrated Supervised Separated Executors. Posse coordinates coding agents in Git repositories. You describe an outcome to a Lead in Herdr. The Lead delegates work to Workers in separate Git worktrees, tracks their progress, and brings their changes back for review and delivery.
8: 
9: ## Install
10: 
11: You need [Herdr](https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr) with protocol 22 or newer, Git, and an agent supported by your Herdr installation. To open pull requests, authenticate the forge CLI for your repository (`gh` for GitHub or `glab` for GitLab).
12: 
13: Review the [installer](install.sh), then run:
14: 
15: ```sh
16: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Thanhbinh1905/posse/main/install.sh | sh
17: ```
18: 
19: The installer downloads the `posse` binary to `~/.local/bin` by default. It asks where posse keeps its data (press Enter for `~/.posse`), then prepares your agents: hooks, the Herdr plugin and the recommended workflow skills. To install only the binary, add `--no-setup` after `sh -s --`; run `posse setup` later.
20: 
21: ## Updating
22: 
23: Direct home upgrades are supported from v0.33.0. Update homes from an older release to v0.33.0 before upgrading further.
24: 
25: ## Delegate your first task
26: 
27: 1. Create a new Herdr workspace: press `Ctrl+B`, then `Shift+N`.
28: 2. In the new workspace's shell, change to your Git repository and run `posse up`. If Posse has not registered the Project, it shows what it found and asks before registering it. You should then see the Lead in this workspace.
29: 3. Tell the Lead what outcome you want, for example: "Fix the CSV export bug; open a PR, don't merge." When the Lead starts a Worker, you should see it in a tab. The Worker uses a separate Git worktree.
30: 
31: To create the workspace from a Herdr shell instead, run `herdr workspace create --cwd /path/to/your/repository --focus`. Then run `posse up` in a shell in the new workspace.
32: 
33: Each Herdr workspace holds one Project and its Lead. Workers use tabs inside that workspace. To work on another Project, create another workspace, not another tab or pane. Local delivery does not run automated verification. Pull-request delivery relies on forge CI at the exact commit being merged. Merge approval follows the Project's configured policy.
34:

86: func normalizedSchema(t *testing.T, db *DB) []string {
87: 	t.Helper()
88: 	rows, err := db.QueryContext(context.Background(), `SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','index','trigger','view') ORDER BY type,name`)
89: 	if err != nil {
90: 		t.Fatal(err)
91: 	}
92: 	defer rows.Close()
93: 	var schema []string
94: 	for rows.Next() {
95: 		var kind, name, table string
96: 		var statement sql.NullString
97: 		if err := rows.Scan(&kind, &name, &table, &statement); err != nil {
98: 			t.Fatal(err)
99: 		}
100: 		if statement.Valid {
101: 			schema = append(schema, fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%s|%s", kind, name, table, normalizeSQL(statement.String)))
102: 		}
103: 	}
104: 	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
105: 		t.Fatal(err)
106: 	}
107: 	sort.Strings(schema)
108: 	return schema
109: }

111: func normalizeSQL(statement string) string {
112: 	statement = strings.Join(strings.Fields(statement), " ")
113: 	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " (", "(")
114: 	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, "( ", "(")
115: 	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " )", ")")
116: 	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " ,", ",")
117: 	return statement
118: }

120: func schemaDifference(want, got []string) string {

+func prepareSupportedHomeAtVersion(t *testing.T, db *DB, version int64) {
+	t.Helper()
+	ctx := context.Background()
+	for _, statement := range []string{
+		`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS greenhouse_task_watches`,
+		`ALTER TABLE project_lookout_pollers DROP COLUMN executable_version`,
+		`ALTER TABLE project_lookout_pollers DROP COLUMN executable_modified_at`,
+		`ALTER TABLE project_lookout_pollers DROP COLUMN executable_size`,
+		`DROP INDEX IF EXISTS tasks_project_seq_idx`,
+		`DROP INDEX IF EXISTS tasks_project_pane_label_idx`,
+		`DROP INDEX IF EXISTS tasks_project_workflow_idx`,
+		`DROP TABLE IF EXISTS task_plan_input_migration`,
+		`ALTER TABLE tasks DROP COLUMN plan_revision`,
+		`ALTER TABLE tasks DROP COLUMN workflow_run_id`,
+		`DELETE FROM goose_db_version`,
+		`DELETE FROM posse_migration_checksums`,
+		`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(0,1)`,
+		`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(95,1)`,
+		`INSERT INTO posse_migration_checksums(version,sha256) VALUES(95,'` + supportedLegacyMigrationChecksums[95] + `')`,
+	} {
+		if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, statement); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	sources, err := embeddedMigrations()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, source := range sources {
+		if source.version <= 95 || source.version > version || source.version >= baselineMigrationVersion {
+			continue
+		}
+		if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(?,1)`, source.version); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if _, err := db.ExecContext(ctx, `INSERT INTO posse_migration_checksums(version,sha256) VALUES(?,?)`, source.version, source.checksum); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+}

+func TestOpenRefusesHomesOlderThanMinimumSupportedVersion(t *testing.T) {

+func containsAll(s string, parts ...string) bool {
+	for _, part := range parts {
+		if !strings.Contains(s, part) {
+			return false
+		}
+	}
+	return true
+}

index 0000000..8db00c6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/internal/store/migration_baseline_fixture_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,141 @@
+package store
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"database/sql"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"sort"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+type schemaFixture struct {
+	Objects []struct {
+		Type  string `json:"type"`
+		Name  string `json:"name"`
+		Table string `json:"table"`
+		SQL   string `json:"sql"`
+	} `json:"objects"`
+	AppliedMigrations []struct {
+		Version  int64  `json:"version"`
+		Checksum string `json:"checksum"`
+	} `json:"applied_migrations"`
+}
+
+func TestV033HomeUpgradesToBaselineSchema(t *testing.T) {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("testdata", "v033.0-schema.json"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var fixture schemaFixture
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &fixture); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	legacyPath := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "legacy.db")
+	legacy, err := sql.Open("sqlite", legacyPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer legacy.Close()
+	sort.Slice(fixture.Objects, func(i, j int) bool {
+		order := map[string]int{"table": 0, "index": 1, "trigger": 2, "view": 3}
+		if order[fixture.Objects[i].Type] != order[fixture.Objects[j].Type] {
+			return order[fixture.Objects[i].Type] < order[fixture.Objects[j].Type]
+		}
+		return fixture.Objects[i].Name < fixture.Objects[j].Name
+	})
+	for _, object := range fixture.Objects {
+		if _, err := legacy.Exec(object.SQL); err != nil {
+			t.Fatalf("apply v0.33.0 %s %s DDL: %v", object.Type, object.Name, err)
+		}
+	}
+	if _, err := legacy.Exec(`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(0,1)`); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	for _, migration := range fixture.AppliedMigrations {
+		if _, err := legacy.Exec(`INSERT INTO goose_db_version(version_id,is_applied) VALUES(?,1)`, migration.Version); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if _, err := legacy.Exec(`INSERT INTO posse_migration_checksums(version,sha256) VALUES(?,?)`, migration.Version, migration.Checksum); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+	}
+	if err := legacy.Close(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	upgraded, err := OpenAt(legacyPath)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("upgrade v0.33.0 home: %v", err)
+	}
+	defer upgraded.Close()
+	fresh, err := OpenAt(filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "fresh.db"))
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("open fresh baseline home: %v", err)
+	}
+	defer fresh.Close()
+	got := normalizedSchema(t, upgraded)
+	want := normalizedSchema(t, fresh)
+	if strings.Join(got, "\n") != strings.Join(want, "\n") {
+		t.Fatalf("upgraded schema differs from fresh baseline:\n%s", schemaDifference(want, got))
+	}
+}
+
+func normalizedSchema(t *testing.T, db *DB) []string {
+	t.Helper()
+	rows, err := db.QueryContext(context.Background(), `SELECT type,name,tbl_name,sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type IN ('table','index','trigger','view') ORDER BY type,name`)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer rows.Close()
+	var schema []string
+	for rows.Next() {
+		var kind, name, table string
+		var statement sql.NullString
+		if err := rows.Scan(&kind, &name, &table, &statement); err != nil {
+			t.Fatal(err)
+		}
+		if statement.Valid {
+			schema = append(schema, fmt.Sprintf("%s|%s|%s|%s", kind, name, table, normalizeSQL(statement.String)))
+		}
+	}
+	if err := rows.Err(); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	sort.Strings(schema)
+	return schema
+}
+
+func normalizeSQL(statement string) string {
+	statement = strings.Join(strings.Fields(statement), " ")
+	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " (", "(")
+	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, "( ", "(")
+	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " )", ")")
+	statement = strings.ReplaceAll(statement, " ,", ",")
+	return statement
+}
+
+func schemaDifference(want, got []string) string {
+	wantSet, gotSet := map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}
+	for _, statement := range want {
+		wantSet[statement] = true
+	}
+	for _, statement := range got {
+		gotSet[statement] = true
+	}
+	var differences []string
+	for statement := range wantSet {
+		if !gotSet[statement] {
+			differences = append(differences, "missing: "+statement)
+		}
+	}
+	for statement := range gotSet {
+		if !wantSet[statement] {
+			differences = append(differences, "extra: "+statement)
+		}
+	}
+	sort.Strings(differences)
+	return strings.Join(differences, "\n")
+}

2: 
3: # Posse
4: 
5: **One Lead. A whole crew. Running on Herdr.**
6: 
7: The name stands for Personal Orchestrated Supervised Separated Executors. Posse coordinates coding agents in Git repositories. You describe an outcome to a Lead in Herdr. The Lead delegates work to Workers in separate Git worktrees, tracks their progress, and brings their changes back for review and delivery.
8: 
9: ## Install
10: 
11: You need [Herdr](https://github.com/herdrdev/herdr) with protocol 22 or newer, Git, and an agent supported by your Herdr installation. To open pull requests, authenticate the forge CLI for your repository (`gh` for GitHub or `glab` for GitLab).
12: 
13: Review the [installer](install.sh), then run:
14: 
15: ```sh
16: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Thanhbinh1905/posse/main/install.sh | sh
17: ```
18: 
19: The installer downloads the `posse` binary to `~/.local/bin` by default. It asks where posse keeps its data (press Enter for `~/.posse`), then prepares your agents: hooks, the Herdr plugin and the recommended workflow skills. To install only the binary, add `--no-setup` after `sh -s --`; run `posse setup` later.
20: 
21: ## Updating
22: 
23: Direct home upgrades are supported from v0.33.0. Update homes from an older release to v0.33.0 before upgrading further.
24: 
25: ## Delegate your first task
26: 
27: 1. Create a new Herdr workspace: press `Ctrl+B`, then `Shift+N`.
28: 2. In the new workspace's shell, change to your Git repository and run `posse up`. If Posse has not registered the Project, it shows what it found and asks before registering it. You should then see the Lead in this workspace.
29: 3. Tell the Lead what outcome you want, for example: "Fix the CSV export bug; open a PR, don't merge." When the Lead starts a Worker, you should see it in a tab. The Worker uses a separate Git worktree.
30: 
31: To create the workspace from a Herdr shell instead, run `herdr workspace create --cwd /path/to/your/repository --focus`. Then run `posse up` in a shell in the new workspace.
32: 
33: Each Herdr workspace holds one Project and its Lead. Workers use tabs inside that workspace. To work on another Project, create another workspace, not another tab or pane. Local delivery does not run automated verification. Pull-request delivery relies on forge CI at the exact commit being merged. Merge approval follows the Project's configured policy.

-- +goose Up
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approvals (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL
, branch_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS branch_author_invalidated_verdicts (
    task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    change_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invalidated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS branch_authorship (
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    branch TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt > 0),
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (repository, branch)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS budget_crossings (
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project_id, scope, scope_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ci_reruns (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    repo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    pr_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    check_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('cancelled', 'flake', 'steward')),
    tests_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (outcome IN ('pending', 'passed', 'failed', 'request_failed')),
    requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    settled_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ci_test_failures (
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    repo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    pr_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    check_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    package TEXT NOT NULL,
    test TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, pr_url, head_sha, check_name, job_id, package, test)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS completed_rider_busy (
    task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id),
    transition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES transitions(id),
    pane_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    server_started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    busy_since INTEGER NOT NULL
, turn_ended INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, baseline TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', resumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "config_approvals" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('set', 'unset', 'move')),
    value TEXT,
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(user_quote)) > 0),
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((action IN ('set', 'move') AND value IS NOT NULL) OR (action = 'unset' AND value IS NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS decision_notice_cursors (
    project_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES projects(id),
    last_notice_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS decisions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    origin TEXT NOT NULL,
    question TEXT NOT NULL,
    options_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    answer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    answered_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', task_launches INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, obsolete_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, obsolete_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', answer_actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', answer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE(project_id, origin)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deliveries (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    repo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    pr_url TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (pr_url <> ''),
    steward TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lead' CHECK (steward IN ('lead')),
    origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('publish', 'legacy')),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (task_id, repo, pr_url)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS delivery_operations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES deliveries(id),
    operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('inspect', 'reply', 'refresh', 'rerun', 'executor_policy')),
    actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor IN ('lead', 'user')),
    actor_pane TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    baseline TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('pending', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'uncertain')),
    detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    pane_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    data_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fix_round_provider_findings (
    fix_round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES validation_fix_rounds(id),
    finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES provider_findings(id),
    pattern_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (fix_round_id, finding_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS greenhouse_task_watches (
    task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id),
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    stage TEXT NOT NULL,
    run_observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stage_observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    run_started_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    stage_started_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    stage_finished_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pane_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS greenhouse_review_requests (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    repo TEXT NOT NULL,
    requested_head TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(requested_head) IN (40, 64)),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider = 'greenhouse'),
    requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    settled_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('verdict', 'refused', 'failed', 'head_mismatch')),
    verdict_id INTEGER REFERENCES verdicts(id),
    grant_id TEXT,
    CHECK (outcome <> 'verdict' OR verdict_id IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intents (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    command TEXT NOT NULL,
    step TEXT NOT NULL,
    process_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', process_boot_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', process_start_time TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE(task_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS interventions (

-- +goose Up
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS approvals (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    action TEXT NOT NULL,
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL,
    at INTEGER NOT NULL
, branch_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS branch_author_invalidated_verdicts (
    task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    change_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    invalidated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS branch_authorship (
    repository TEXT NOT NULL,
    branch TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    attempt INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (attempt > 0),
    generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation > 0),
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (repository, branch)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS budget_crossings (
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    scope TEXT NOT NULL,
    scope_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY(project_id, scope, scope_key)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ci_reruns (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    repo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    pr_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    check_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    reason TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (reason IN ('cancelled', 'flake', 'steward')),
    tests_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (outcome IN ('pending', 'passed', 'failed', 'request_failed')),
    requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    settled_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS ci_test_failures (
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    repo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    pr_url TEXT NOT NULL,
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL,
    check_name TEXT NOT NULL,
    job_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    package TEXT NOT NULL,
    test TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (project_id, pr_url, head_sha, check_name, job_id, package, test)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS completed_rider_busy (
    task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id),
    transition_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES transitions(id),
    pane_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    server_started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
    busy_since INTEGER NOT NULL
, turn_ended INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, baseline TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', resumed INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "config_approvals" (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    key TEXT NOT NULL,
    action TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (action IN ('set', 'unset', 'move')),
    value TEXT,
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(user_quote)) > 0),
    at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    CHECK ((action IN ('set', 'move') AND value IS NOT NULL) OR (action = 'unset' AND value IS NULL))
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS decision_notice_cursors (
    project_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES projects(id),
    last_notice_id INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS decisions (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    origin TEXT NOT NULL,
    question TEXT NOT NULL,
    options_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    answer TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    user_quote TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    answered_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', task_launches INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, obsolete_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, obsolete_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', answer_actor TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user', answer_reason TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    UNIQUE(project_id, origin)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS deliveries (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    repo TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    pr_url TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (pr_url <> ''),
    steward TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'lead' CHECK (steward IN ('lead')),
    origin TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (origin IN ('publish', 'legacy')),
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (task_id, repo, pr_url)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS delivery_operations (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    delivery_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES deliveries(id),
    operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('inspect', 'reply', 'refresh', 'rerun', 'executor_policy')),
    actor TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (actor IN ('lead', 'user')),
    actor_pane TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    head_sha TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    subject TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    baseline TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('pending', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'uncertain')),
    detail TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS events (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    received_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind TEXT NOT NULL,
    pane_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    data_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS fix_round_provider_findings (
    fix_round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES validation_fix_rounds(id),
    finding_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES provider_findings(id),
    pattern_seq INTEGER NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (fix_round_id, finding_id)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS greenhouse_task_watches (
    task_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES tasks(id),
    run_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    stage TEXT NOT NULL,
    run_observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    stage_observed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    run_started_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    stage_started_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    stage_finished_at INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    pane_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS greenhouse_review_requests (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
    task_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tasks(id),
    repo TEXT NOT NULL,
    requested_head TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(requested_head) IN (40, 64)),
    provider TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (provider = 'greenhouse'),
    requested_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    settled_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('verdict', 'refused', 'failed', 'head_mismatch')),
    verdict_id INTEGER REFERENCES verdicts(id),
    grant_id TEXT,
    CHECK (outcome <> 'verdict' OR verdict_id IS NOT NULL)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS intents (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id),
